title: Redundancy Counting
description: Redundancy Counting is a reliability ability in the Automated Backup Redundancy Audits database. Counts live copies of every dataset and flags anything under its target. Each dataset declares a target copy count; the auditor inventories actual copies hourly. It takes dataset registry and produces copy report. Tunable parameters: hourly. Guarantee: under-target datasets always alert.

fields.mechanism: Each dataset declares a target copy count; the auditor inventories actual copies hourly.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Restore Drills
description: Restore Drills is a reliability ability in the Automated Backup Redundancy Audits database. Rehearses full restores on a schedule so restores work when they must. Drills restore to an isolated sandbox and verify checksums; results are recorded. It takes schedule and produces drill reports. Tunable parameters: monthly. Guarantee: drills never touch production.

fields.mechanism: Drills restore to an isolated sandbox and verify checksums; results are recorded.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Checksum Verification
description: Checksum Verification is a reliability ability in the Automated Backup Redundancy Audits database. Verifies backup checksums continuously, not just at write time. Stored checksums are recomputed on a rolling schedule; mismatches quarantine the copy. It takes backup store and produces verification log. Tunable parameters: rolling. Guarantee: mismatched copies are never trusted.

fields.mechanism: Stored checksums are recomputed on a rolling schedule; mismatches quarantine the copy.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Geographic Spread
description: Geographic Spread is a reliability ability in the Automated Backup Redundancy Audits database. Ensures copies live in independent failure domains. Copy locations are checked against region and provider; correlated copies are flagged. It takes copy locations and produces spread report. Tunable parameters: min 2 regions. Guarantee: all copies in one region always fail.

fields.mechanism: Copy locations are checked against region and provider; correlated copies are flagged.
fields.guarantees: all copies in one region always fail

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Retention Enforcement
description: Retention Enforcement is a reliability ability in the Automated Backup Redundancy Audits database. Enforces retention policies — keeps what must be kept, deletes what must go. Policies per dataset drive keep/delete decisions; deletions are logged and reversible for 30 days. It takes policies and produces enforcement log. Tunable parameters: per dataset. Guarantee: deletions are never silent.

fields.mechanism: Policies per dataset drive keep/delete decisions; deletions are logged and reversible for 30 days.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: RPO Tracking
description: RPO Tracking is a reliability ability in the Automated Backup Redundancy Audits database. Tracks recovery-point objectives against actual backup freshness. The freshest backup per dataset is compared to its RPO; breaches page the owner. It takes backup timestamps and produces RPO status. Tunable parameters: per dataset. Guarantee: breaches always page.

fields.mechanism: The freshest backup per dataset is compared to its RPO; breaches page the owner.

Drill timings feed the RTO record; datasets missing RTO three drills running get flagged. It takes drill timings and produces RTO record. Tunable parameters: per dataset. Guarantee: RTO is measured, never estimated.

Guarantee: unencrypted backups always fail.

title: Immutable Snapshots
description: Immutable Snapshots is a reliability ability in the Automated Backup Redundancy Audits database. Keeps tamper-proof snapshots that even admins cannot rewrite. Snapshots are write-once with retention locks; deletes before expiry are refused. It takes snapshot store and produces locked snapshots. Tunable parameters: WORM. Guarantee: locked snapshots are never mutable.

title: Backup Deduplication
description: Backup Deduplication is a reliability ability in the Automated Backup Redundancy Audits database. Deduplicates backup content to save space without losing copies. Content-defined chunking finds duplicates; unique chunks are stored once with references. It takes backup data and produces dedup store. Tunable parameters: chunked. Guarantee: deduplication never merges distinct data.
